problem: Which of the following gives the coordinates of the maximum point of the function $y=\operatorname{arccos}⁡x?$
worked_solution:
Let's recall the graph of $y=\operatorname{arccos}⁡x.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13962979/assets/d2677563c82c37fd1672a806a18524c97ea5ec17cb4f8ef6d8df23b827ba5e81.png)

From the graph, we see that the maximum value is $\pi $ and it is reached at $x=-1.$ Therefore, the coordinates of the maximum point of the function are $(-1,\pi ).$
